fusions.name: The Drop
fusions.desc: Drops a hung blade on the target that deals 22 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Pendulum Edge
fusions.desc: Releases a hung blade that swings through a wide arc ahead of you. It deals 15 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles in the arc, knocks each back 2 tiles and leaves it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Counterweight
fusions.desc: Raises your damage by 30% for 12 seconds. A hung blade swings beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: One Trips the Next
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a blade drops on the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
